content:
Nina: kicking off OrionCare priv/VPC handoff thread. Checklist: VPN (WireGuard vs IPSec), control-plane ports, cross-account IAM role, KMS alias + key policy, CloudTrail + S3 bucket settings, and Splunk/Sumo forwarding. Call out any immediate blockers.
Omar: Network note: they prefer WireGuard. Need UDP 51820 and ensure their NAT gateway preserves source port. Ask them to avoid port translations that rewrite source IPs. Also request MTU 1420 to avoid fragmentation.
Priya (Customer): WireGuard fine. I'll ask infra to open UDP 51820 and ensure NAT preserves ports. Their windows are 2300-0000 UTC.
Sonal: IAM: cross-account role must be named exactly `RedwoodPrivAccess` (case-sensitive). Trust policy must allow sts:AssumeRole from our account 210987654321. Common failure: adding MFA condition. Do not require MFA on that role.
Diego: KMS: alias must start alias/redwood/orioncare. Key policy must grant our service principal arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/redwood-priv-svc kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey*. If they enable automatic rotation, tag us 24h before rotating.
Priya (Customer): can you paste a minimal policy we can attach?
Sonal: Minimal policy snippet:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/redwood-priv-svc"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```
Nina: Observability: they want 180-day retention. Our pipeline forwards to Splunk index `orion_priv_audit` in JSONL. Confirm their Splunk team allows our collector IPs and the index.
Priya (Customer): Splunk needs collector IPs and the sample JSON schema. Where can I get those?
Omar: runbook link has CIDRs and schema: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/privnet-onboard#orioncare. I'll DM collector IPs as well.
onboard-bot: onboarding-status: network(pending), iam(pending), kms(pending), logs(pending). See https://redwood.internal/onboard/3344556677/status
Diego: Security note: ensure CloudTrail multi-region enabled and S3 bucket does NOT have Object Lock; Object Lock prevents our processing. Also make sure bucket encryption is SSE-KMS using the same key alias.
Priya (Customer): I'll confirm CloudTrail + bucket settings. ETA EOD.
Nina: Renewal watch: billing-bot flagged medium renewal-risk due to expected scale. If onboarding is blocked >48h tag `renewal-risk` and loop AMs.
billing-bot: renewal-watch: projected usage spike next billing cycle; tag and alert if >48h unresolved blocks.
Omar: Action items: 1) Priya open UDP51820 and ensure NAT preserves source ports (Priya) 2) Create role `RedwoodPrivAccess` and share ARN (Priya) 3) Create KMS alias alias/redwood/orioncare and attach policy (Priya + Diego) 4) Confirm Splunk collector IPs and index `orion_priv_audit` (Priya) 5) Confirm CloudTrail multi-region + S3 Object Lock off (Priya).
Priya (Customer): I'll start ticket with infra; will update after the maintenance window tonight.
Sonal: small docs follow-up: I'll add WireGuard port and NAT note to quickstart to prevent future friction.
Nina: thanks everyone 44d reconvene after the window or earlier if needed.
